segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to effect a business combination; it has no operations and generates no operating revenue.
segments.evidence: The Company is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a Business Combination.

revenueModel.text: No operating revenue before a business combination; its only income is interest earned on funds held in the Trust Account.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company will generate non-operating income in the form of interest income on the investments held in the Trust Account.
